title: 4811 Movements of Well-known Bolsheviks

Shanghai Municipal Police.

Hongkew
14th. November 192 .

REPORT ON Movements of well-known Bolsheviks.
Leonidoff and his satellites.

Made by D. C. Repas. Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence.

Sir,

I beg to report that Leonidoff and Gvasdaroff
junior left Shanghai on the S. S. Heily for Vladivostok to-day.
The first-named ( I have previously reported
on this man ) is the plenipotentiary of the Moscow Government
and a member of the Central Propaganda Bureau of Soviet Russia
( Organisation of "III International" ) and was in Shanghai for
the purpose of supplying money and giving instructions to the
various local Chinese Bolshevik organisations. His wife, Mrs.
Leonidoff is still in Shanghai. Their last known address is
151, Avenue Dubail. The pair were in close touch with Dr.
Portoonatoff, chief of the local "Cheka" and with Morosoff,
the president of the "Centrosojuz". The address of Portoonatoff
is 20 60C, Rue de l'Observatoire" and that off Morosoff, 624,
Rue de l'Observatoire.

Leonidoff and Gvasdaroff Junior were accompanied
to the ship by Alexandroff, the captain of the S. S. Eniven and
a prominent Bolshevik, and Gvasdaroff Senior who is known to be
an active member of the local Bolshevik propaganda
organisation. Gvasdaroff Senior was formerly a member of the
military Intelligence Dept. at Vladivostock during the Rosenoff
regime. This man speaks Chinese fluently and can write and read
characters, and for this reason he is indispensable to his
comrades. [The attention of the Police must be drawn to this
matter as] He is undoubtedly a valuable medium between the
local Russian and Chinese Bolshevik parties. Richterman of the
Occasional Goods Store, Palace Hotel Bldg, was present with
